title: Identifying Small Molecules Promoting Cardiomyocyte Proliferation in Rats and Mice
author: Zheng, Wang, et al.

steps.title: Amplify and Purify Virus
steps.instruction: Seed 30–40 × 10‑cm dishes of HEK293 cells; when they reach 70–80 % confluence add 10 µL of virus (~10⁷–10⁸ PFU/mL) to each plate and incubate 2–3 days. Then lyse cells with 500 µL 10 % NP40, collect lysates and centrifuge at 7,000 g for 10 min; discard pellet and keep supernatant. Add 50 mL virus‑precipitation solution (20 % PEG8000, 2.5 M NaCl) per 100 mL supernatant, keep on ice 1 h, and centrifuge at 7,000 g for 20 min. Discard supernatant, suspend pellet in 10 mL CsCl solution (density 1.10 g/mL, 20 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.0). In a Beckman ultracentrifuge tube add 2.0 mL of 1.40 g/mL CsCl, then 3.0 mL of 1.30 g/mL CsCl, followed by 5 mL virus suspension. Ultracentrifuge at 159,800 g for 2.5 h at 4 °C. Collect viral bands of density 1.30–1.40 g/mL into a dialysis bag (pre‑boiled 10 min in 10 mM EDTA‑Na₂). Dialyze overnight (12–18 h) at 4 °C, changing dialysate once midway. Finally collect and store virus at –80 °C.

Incubate 2–3 days.
Add 500 µL 10 % NP40 to lyse cells.

Add 50 mL 20 % PEG8000 / 2.5 M NaCl per 100 mL supernatant; ice 1 h.
Centrifuge at 7,000 g for 20 min; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 10 mL 1.10 g/mL CsCl (20 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.0).
Add 2.0 mL 1.40 g/mL CsCl, then 3.0 mL 1.30 g/mL CsCl, then 5 mL virus suspension.
Ultracentrifuge at 159,800 g for 2.5 h at 4 °C.
Collect bands (1.30–1.40 g/mL) into pre‑boiled dialysis bag (10 mM EDTA‑Na₂, 10 min).
Dialyze 12–18 h at 4 °C, change dialysate once.
Store purified virus at –80 °C.

steps.title: Genotype and Cross MADM Mice
steps.instruction: Genotype homozygous MADM‑ML‑11TG and MADM‑ML‑11GT mice by PCR using the primers listed in Table 2. Then generate MADM‑ML‑11TG/GT mice by crossing a homozygous TG mouse with a homozygous GT mouse. (Timing: 8 weeks).

substeps.instruction: Perform PCR genotyping of MADM‑ML‑11TG mice (Table 2).
Perform PCR genotyping of MADM‑ML‑11GT mice (Table 2).
Cross a homozygous TG mouse with a homozygous GT mouse to obtain TG/GT offspring.

steps.title: Stain NRVM Nuclei After Treatment
steps.instruction: After 24 h small‑molecule treatment of neonatal rat ventricular myocytes (NRVMs), aspirate the culture medium and stain nuclei with Hoechst 33342 (concentration as used in the original experiment).

steps.title: Capture FUCCI Images with ImageXpress
steps.instruction: Using the MD ImageXpress Micro XL Imaging System (Molecular Devices), acquire images of FUCCI‑positive (mAG‑hGeminin, 1/110) green fluorescent NRVMs. Set the instrument parameters as follows (Table 6): Objective 20×; 9–25 fields per well; depth of focus 3.5 µm; resolution 1280 × 1080; image size 842.64 × 710.98 µm; binning 2. Channel 1: excitation 377 nm, emission 447 nm, exposure 150 ms. Channel 2: excitation 482 nm, emission 536 nm, exposure 150–200 ms. Channel 3 (MADM): excitation 562 nm, emission 624 nm, exposure 150–200 ms. Acquire at least 9 images per well.

steps.title: Capture FUCCI Images with Opera Phenix (optional)
steps.instruction: Optionally acquire the same FUCCI images using the PE Opera Phenix (Perkin Elmer) with the settings in Table 7: Objective 20×; 9–25 fields; depth of focus 4.4 µm; resolution 1080 × 1080; image size 650 × 650 µm; binning 2. Channel 1: excitation 355–385 nm, emission 430–500 nm, exposure 10 ms. Channel 2: excitation 460–490 nm, emission 500–550 nm, exposure 75–200 ms. Channel 3 (MADM): excitation 530–560 nm, emission 570–650 nm, exposure 100–300 ms. Acquire at least 9 images per well and analyze ≥3,000 cells per well.

steps.title: Count FUCCI‑Positive Cells and Calculate Percentage
steps.instruction: Using MetaXpress software, segment cells and count both total nuclei and FUCCI‑positive nuclei. Export the two counts and compute the percentage of FUCCI‑positive NRVMs as (positive nuclei / total nuclei) × 100 %.

substeps.instruction: Import images into MetaXpress and assign channel names.
Use the “Count Nuclei Objects” module to detect Hoechst‑stained nuclei (set width and intensity thresholds above background).
Use the “Cell Scoring Objects” module to identify mAG‑positive nuclei (set fluorescence intensity threshold above background).
Export total nuclei count and positive nuclei count.
Calculate percentage = (positive / total) × 100 % in Excel or similar.

steps.title: Identify Positive Hits and Confirm Candidates
steps.instruction: Define a positive hit as a compound that induces at least a 2‑fold increase in the percentage of FUCCI‑positive NRVMs compared with the negative (DMSO) control. Confirm each candidate small molecule at 2 µM in two independent experiments to verify the effect.

substeps.instruction: Compare each compound’s FUCCI‑positive percentage to the DMSO control.
Select compounds showing ≥2‑fold increase.
Retest selected compounds at 2 µM in duplicate experiments.

steps.title: Analyze Images with MetaXpress
steps.instruction: After imaging with the MD ImageXpress, run the custom MetaXpress module: import images, create channel‑specific names, count nuclei (Hoechst) using intensity thresholds, score mAG‑positive nuclei, export counts, and compute the positive ratio. Optional: perform the same workflow in Harmony software (Perkin Elmer) following the steps below.

substeps.instruction: Import images and assign channel names.
Count nuclei objects (Hoechst) with appropriate width and intensity settings.
Score mAG‑positive nuclei with fluorescence intensity threshold.
Export total and positive nuclei numbers.
Calculate positive ratio in a spreadsheet.

steps.title: Optional Image Analysis with Harmony
steps.instruction: In Harmony, create a new analysis, import images, identify nuclei via Hoechst 33342, adjust nuclear area, split factor, and fluorescence contrast to isolate single nuclei. Apply flat‑field correction (basic or advanced) to remove vignetting. Calculate morphological properties to exclude out‑of‑range nuclei, then set intensity thresholds for mAG to select positive cells. Apply multiple thresholds if needed, define the population, and set the output formula: positive ratio = (selected nuclei / total nuclei) × 100 %.

Set mean fluorescence intensity threshold for mAG to define positive cells.

Select population with high fluorescence.
Define output formula: (selected nuclei / total nuclei) × 100 %.

steps.title: Analyze MADM Cardiomyocytes
steps.instruction: Perform the same MetaXpress (or Harmony) workflow for MADM‑labeled cardiomyocytes, but when counting single‑fluorescent cells add an extra threshold to exclude cells that show fluorescence in any other channel.

substeps.instruction: Run the standard MetaXpress or Harmony pipeline.
Add a channel‑specific exclusion threshold to discard cells with signal in non‑target channels.
